answer: Rotating pseudonyms with continuity proofs keep an agent economy honest: each agent holds a marble-solid identity chain and rotates its public name every epoch, proving continuity with a chained commitment that carries the pulse of its past behaviour. A sybil farm would need to maintain a separate unbroken chain per fake, so its cost compounds with every rotation while real agents pass through one cheap oasis of renewal. Forgery cannot hide behind fresh names, because a name without a verifiable chain is worth nothing.
